society.skycraft.say.region.stonefalls: Ash-clouds from Ash Mountain and Tormented Spire hang warm over the Inner Sea, where Blacklight, Ebonheart, and Davon's Watch guard the mainland heart.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.1: Ash Mountain rumbles under every cobblestone from Davon's Watch to Kragenmoor.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.2: Castle Ebonheart's Imperial bridges carry every chest of East Empire ebony and glass out to the Inner Sea.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.3: Up in Blacklight, the Redoran Archmaster's council sits inside a hollowed emperor crab shell overlooking the fjord.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.4: Don't step off the basalt causeways near Othrenis unless you want lava-leeches on your greaves.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.5: House Indoril's Ordinators still patrol Davon's Watch in gilded bonemold, watching the sea-lanes for raiders.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.6: Kragenmoor's Hlaalu factors can price a kwama egg mine before the first cut is even dug.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.7: At Silgrad Tower, the border-watch keeps one eye on the Velothi passes and the other on the Hlaalu customs gates.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.8: Sulfur vents along the Stonefalls foyadas steam brightest right before an ash-squall rolls down off the peaks.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.9: The Six Fishes in Ebonheart pours Cyrodiilic brandy for the Legion and local sujamma for the dockers.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.10: Every ancestral tomb in the Stonefalls foothills has a brass brazier and a bone-warded lintel.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.11: Senie and Dhalmora ship fungal timber and volcanic pumice across the Inner Sea on flat-bottomed barges.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.12: If you climb toward the Brothers of Strife, carry cure-blight draughts and a silk ash-mask.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.13: In Heimlyn Keep, the reliquary monks guard scripts older than the Armistice.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.14: Even the kwama foragers around Sathram Plantation know when the magma tubes are shifting underfoot.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.15: House Redoran's chitin shield-walls held the western passes when every other banner faltered.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.16: You can smell the brimstone springs of Stonefalls three leagues out on the water.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.17: The Skyrim and Argonian Missions in Ebonheart never stop arguing over shipping tariffs.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.18: A blade quenched in Stonefalls obsidian-ash holds an edge through bonemold and netch-leather alike.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.19: At Iliath Temple, the novices sweep a finger's depth of grey cinder off the courtyard every dawn.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.20: Between the Great Houses and the Imperial Commission, every wharf on the Inner Sea answers to three ledgers.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.21: In Stonefalls, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.22: Travelers passing through Stonefalls soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.23: Every merchant caravan in Stonefalls carries ancestral charms beside its scales and ledgers.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.24: Out on the roads of Stonefalls, a sturdy pair of bonemold greaves is worth twice its weight in Imperial silver.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.25: Ask any elder in Stonefalls and they can recite three centuries of House treaties from memory.
society.skycraft.say.stonefalls.26: Whether by silt strider, coaster skiff, or stone causeway, all paths through Stonefalls answer to ancient custom.

society.skycraft.say.region.deshaan: Across the glowing fungal plains of Deshaan, the great canals of Mournhold, Narsis, and Tear carry the wealth of the Tribunal and the southern Great Houses.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.1: Mournhold—city of light, city of magic! Even from the Deshaan marshes you can see the High Chapel's dome.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.2: In Narsis, House Hlaalu's counting-houses weigh every measure of saltrice, muck-sponge, and ebony from the southern hills.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.3: Down by Tear, House Dres builds its walled compounds on raised canal islands above the silt lagoons.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.4: When night falls over the Deshaan plains, the giant emperor parasols glow blue-green along the caravan roads.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.5: Quarantine Serk stays behind locked palisades whenever swamp-fever or ash-woe drifts down from the north.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.6: At Shad Astula, the mages train both House scions and outlander apprentices in the lakeside towers.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.7: Mournhold's Grand Bazaar has stages for playwrights, stalls for smiths, and sewers full of forgotten Old Mournhold ruins.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.8: Every aqueduct feeding Mournhold was laid in dressed white limestone by Indoril engineers.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.9: In the Hall of Justice, the Ordinators keep the Temple's peace with gilded maces and unblinking masks.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.10: Bull netch drift over the Deshaan paddies like leather lanterns in the afternoon heat.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.11: Don't wander into the Darkshade Caverns without a guide; the kwama queens there are fierce as nix-hounds.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.12: At Muth Gnaar, the monks tend the healing shrines for pilgrims walking the southern road to Almalexia's seat.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.13: King Helseth's Royal Guard wears crimson and black steel that outshines the Ordinators on Godsreach.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.14: The Obsidian Gorge cuts straight through the middle of Deshaan—one bad ambush can choke the whole trade road.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.15: Winged twilights and nix-oxen nest in the cliffs above the River Thir.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.16: A Hlaalu bond-script from Narsis is good for gold in every port from Ebonheart to Wayrest.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.17: In Silent Mire, the reed-gatherers pole skiffs beneath fungal caps wider than a manor roof.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.18: Every shrine in Deshaan burns sweet marsh-myrrh and saltrice incense at vespers.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.19: Even the craftsmen on Brindisi Dorom know that Mournhold rests atop a second, buried city.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.20: Keep your boots oiled in southern Deshaan; where the fungal plain meets Black Marsh, the peat never dries.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.21: In Deshaan, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.deshaan.22: Travelers passing through Deshaan soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.

society.skycraft.say.region.molag_amur: Black cinder-cones and lava crusts stretch across Molag Amur from Mount Nabia to the white cliffside mausoleums of Necrom on the Padomaic Sea.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.1: In Necrom, the City of the Dead, everyGreat House brings its ancestors inbone-ash urns to rest in the white cliff catacombs.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.2: Not a single river runs across Molag Amur's lava crust—travelers live from one pilgrim cistern to the next.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.3: The Bone-Binders of Necrom walk the white bridges by lantern-light, chanting the names of the honoured dead.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.4: Out on the cinder plains of Molag Amur, cliffracers and kagouti hunt along the edges of the foyadas.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.5: Bthar-Zel's Dwemer brass doors still hiss with geothermal steam where the lava tubes meet the sea cliffs.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.6: No thief dares break a tomb-seal in Necrom while the Watch-Ordinators patrol the white terraces.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.7: Ash-storms off Mount Kand can bury a guar pack-train in half an hour if you miss the wayshrine cairns.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.8: Every funeral barge pulling into Necrom's harbour rings a single bronze bell across the grey mist.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.9: Along the Foyada Bani-Dad, the obsidian glass is sharp enough to slice through a guar's hoof-pad.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.10: Pilgrims bound for Mount Kand carry riddles and offerings for the shrines of Vivec's wisdom.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.11: At Marandus and the old Velothi domes, bandits and ash-exiles shelter behind two-yard basalt walls.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.12: In the Cathedral of the Ancestors, a thousand votive candles burn day and night without throwing heat.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.13: Only hardy scathecraw and trama root can grip the pumice ridges of central Molag Amur.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.14: House Indoril's prelates govern Necrom by ancient funerary law that predates the Imperial charter.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.15: Watch for lava-blisters under the ash crust; one false step drops you into red-hot scoria.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.16: The embalmer-apothecaries of Necrom trade in grave-myrrh, bonemeal, and blessed salt.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.17: Even the Ashlanders give wide berth to the haunted Daedric spires rising from Molag Amur's slag flats.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.18: When the eastern sea-fog meets Molag Amur's cinder heat, the coast steams like a cauldron.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.19: A pilgrim who walks from Molag Mar to Necrom earns the blessing of every saint on the road.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.20: Here between the volcano's shadow and the white necropolis, the living walk softly among the dead.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.21: In Molag Amur, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.molag_amur.22: Travelers passing through Molag Amur soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.

society.skycraft.say.region.telvannis: Along the eastern peninsula and the islands of Zafirbel Bay, House Telvanni grows colossal emperor-parasol towers above black-sand coves and steaming Dwemer reefs.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.1: In Sadrith Mora and Port Telvannis, if you cannot levitate to the council chambers, your petition wasn't worth hearing.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.2: Master Neloth in Tel Naga cares more for a well-brewed cup of canis root tea than for the entire Imperial Legion.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.3: Out at Wolverine Hall, the Imperial garrison crowds three guilds and a shrine into one cramped stone keep.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.4: House Telvanni's law is simple: if you win the argument—or the duel—you were in the right.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.5: In Port Telvannis, the root-towers of Archmagister Gothren rise so high their caps catch the first dawn off the Padomaic.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.6: Firewatch stands on the northern headland as an Imperial charter port, forever glaring across the bay at the Telvanni wizards.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.7: Our retainers shape living fungus with song-salts and alteration magic instead of laying mortar and brick.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.8: Down in Zafirbel Bay, Dwemer steam-pipes still bubble up through the coral reefs and kelp beds.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.9: Don't drink unlabeled potions in Dirty Muriel's Cornerclub unless you enjoy breathing water for a week.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.10: On the island of Gorne, House Indoril's manor gardens keep trim hedges far from Telvanni spore-clouds.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.11: Every Mouth in the Telvanni Council House speaks for a Magister who hasn't left their laboratory in ten years.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.12: Bioluminescent spore-lanterns light the root-causeways of Sadrith Mora when the sea-rain rolls in.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.13: Arkzak's flooded Dwemer galleries beneath the peninsula still hum with tonal brass and centurion gears.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.14: A Telvanni cephalopod helm takes three seasons to harden in chitin-lacquer and alchemical resin.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.15: AtGateway Inn, outlanders sleep in hollowed mushroom pods that smell of sweet myrrh and damp loam.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.16: The black-sand beaches of Telvannis are littered with pumice, pearl-oysters, and dreugh shells.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.17: Even the Mages Guild in Wolverine Hall walks softly around Master Aryon's and Master Neloth's retainers.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.18: If you want master-grade enchanting in Morrowind, you bring your grand soul gems to Zafirbel Bay.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.19: Storms off the Padomaic lash the peninsula cliffs, yet the great fungal spires bend and never snap.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.20: In Telvannis, ambition is a virtue, privacy is sacred, and curiosity is your own responsibility.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.21: In Telvannis, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.22: Travelers passing through Telvannis soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.23: Every merchant caravan in Telvannis carries ancestral charms beside its scales and ledgers.
society.skycraft.say.telvannis.24: Out on the roads of Telvannis, a sturdy pair of bonemold greaves is worth twice its weight in Imperial silver.

society.skycraft.say.region.sheogorad: Wave-cut basalt islets, cold northern squalls, and netch-kelp channels define Sheogorad, from the Nordic-Dwemer towers of Dagon Fel to the ash-swept yurts of the Urshilaku.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.1: Dagon Fel sits at the very end of the world, where Nordic timber roofs lean against ancient Dwemer stone.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.2: In the tavern called The End of the World, harpooners and relic-hunters trade stories over mugs of nord mead and mazte.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.3: Sorkvild the Raven locked himself in the Dwemer tower outside Dagon Fel with his necromancy and his constructs.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.4: Across the water at Sanctus Shrine, the silent monks keep their vows beneath the sea-gulls' cries.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.5: Along the northern beach, the Urshilaku Ashlanders pitch their chitin-ribbed yurts against the Sea of Ghosts wind.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.6: Ashkhan Sul-Matuul and Wise Woman Nibani Maesa guard the old prophecies of the Nerevarine.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.7: Stepping from islet to islet in Sheogorad means watching the tide-rips and the dreugh-reefs.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.8: Out at Ald Redaynia and Vas, bitter necromancers and Daedra-cultists hide in the wave-lashed towers.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.9: Horkers and netch share the same rocky skerries whenever the northern pack-ice drifts south.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.10: A fisherman in Dagon Fel learns to read the fog-banks before he learns to tie a net-knot.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.11: The Orcs holding Valenvaryon keep their own council behind the ruined Velothi stronghold walls.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.12: Every roof in Sheogorad is weighted with basalt boulders so the winter gales don't strip the shingles.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.13: Pearl-divers in the cold channels grease their skin with netch-fat before plunging into the kelp forests.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.14: No Great House tax-collector bothers rowing out to Sheogorad when the autumn squalls set in.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.15: At the Urshilaku Burial Caverns, ancestor-ghosts guard the cairns of dead Ashkhans.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.16: Look for the glowing russula and violet coprinus growing in the lee of the basalt stacks.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.17: Between the smugglers' coves and the Daedric shrines, half the islets in Sheogorad have no name on Imperial maps.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.18: When the northern aurora lights the Sea of Ghosts, the Dwemer domes round Dagon Fel gleam like cold brass.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.19: Bring dry kindling if you camp on the heath; driftwood in Sheogorad is soaked in brine to the core.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.20: Out here on the northern archipelagos, the sea gives, the sea takes, and the wind never stops.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.21: In Sheogorad, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.22: Travelers passing through Sheogorad soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.23: Every merchant caravan in Sheogorad carries ancestral charms beside its scales and ledgers.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.24: Out on the roads of Sheogorad, a sturdy pair of bonemold greaves is worth twice its weight in Imperial silver.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.25: Ask any elder in Sheogorad and they can recite three centuries of House treaties from memory.
society.skycraft.say.sheogorad.26: Whether by silt strider, coaster skiff, or stone causeway, all paths through Sheogorad answer to ancient custom.

society.skycraft.say.region.vvardenfell_: Swept by red blight-winds off the caldera, the Vvardenfell Ashlands are the testing-ground of House Redoran under the giant shell of Ald'ruhn and the nomadic Ashlander tribes.
society.skycraft.say.vvardenfell_ashland: In Ald'ruhn, the great council halls of House Redoran shelter beneath Skar—the hollowed carapace of an ancient emperor crab.
When the ash-storm rises, pull your goggles down and follow the whistling street-cairns from Manor District to the Temple.
Archmaster Athyn Sarethi holds House Redoran to duty, gravity, and piety even when the blight-winds howl.
Up in Gnisis, the Imperial Legion at Fort Darius guards the richest kwama egg mine in northwestern Vvardenfell.
Master Baladas Demnevanni lives in Arvs-Drelen right in the middle of Gnisis with a tame clanfear and zero patience for taxmen.
Maar Gan's shrine holds the sacred boulder that Saint Veloth—or Vivec—hurled at Mehrunes Dagon.
Out on the grey plains, the Foyada Mamaea and Foyada Bani-Dad cut straight down from Red Mountain's rim.
Khuul's stilt-houses cling to the northern rocks where smugglers and netch-boats slip out to Solstheim.
At Ald Velothi, the Redoran watchtower looks down over the coastal marshes and the Ashlander trails.
Kogoruhn's half-buried Dunmer domes out on the northern ash-flat still reek of Sixth House corprus and ash-statues.
Every Redoran guard in Ald'ruhn polishes his bonemold cuirass with pumice and guar-tallow after a storm.
In The Rat in the Pot, operatives who know the right passwords can settle quiet business over sujamma.
Nothing tests an outlander faster than walking from Ald'ruhn to Maar Gan against a headwind of scoria grit.
Silt striders groan across the ash-flats on spindly legs, carrying passengers above the nix-hound packs.
At Buckmoth Legion Fort, the Imperial knights and Redoran retainers share watch over the southern foyada.
Ash-yams and corkbulb root thrive in the volcanic dust where no heartland wheat could ever sprout.
The Ashlanders say the wind off Red Mountain carries the whispers of every broken oath since Battle of Red Mountain.
At Bal Isra, the new Redoran stronghold rises in curved adobe to hold the pass between Ald'ruhn and Maar Gan.
Never sleep in an unwarded ancestral tomb on the ash-plain unless you enjoy conversing with bonewalkers.
Duty, gravity, and piety—without all three, the Ashlands will strip the flesh from your bones.
In Vvardenfell Ashlands, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
Travelers passing through Vvardenfell Ashlands soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.
Every merchant caravan in Vvardenfell Ashlands carries ancestral charms beside its scales and ledgers.
Out on the roads of Vvardenfell Ashlands, a sturdy pair of bonemold greaves is worth twice its weight in Imperial silver.
Ask any elder in Vvardenfell Ashlands and they can recite three centuries of House treaties from memory.
Whether by silt strider, coaster skiff, or stone causeway, all paths through Vvardenfell Ashlands answer to ancient custom.

society.skycraft.say.region.grazelands: Sheltered in the eastern lee of the mountains, the golden wickwheat steppes of the Grazelands feed the herds of the Zainab and Ahemmusa Ashlanders beneath the roots of Tel Vos.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.1: Here in the Grazelands, the ash-storms break against the western ridges and leave our wickwheat steppes golden and clear.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.2: Tel Vos is a marvel and a warning—Master Aryon grew a Telvanni mushroom tower straight through the stones of an Imperial fort.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.3: In the village of Vos down by the shore, farmers and fishermen trade saltrice and hackle-lo with Tel Vos's retainers.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.4: Out on the open steppe, the Zainab Camp's yurts follow the wild guar herds from spring to autumn.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.5: In Tel Mora, Mistress Dratha permits no men to dwell within her fungal island compound.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.6: Up near Ald Daedroth, the ruined shrine on the island hums with Sheogorath's and Mehrunes Dagon's warring cultists.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.7: Sinnammu Mirpal, Wise Woman of the Ahemmusa, keeps her people's peace along the northeastern coast.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.8: Hackle-lo leaf from the Grazelands is sweet enough to chew raw on a long march.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.9: Watch the golden saint and atronach conjurations around the Telvanni towers—the apprentices practice in the open fields.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.10: Maesa-Shammus Egg Mine produces enough kwama eggs to feed every canton on the eastern coast.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.11: A Zainab Ashlander can judge a man's worth by the health of his pack-guar and the edge of his chitin spear.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.12: Even the kagouti and nix-hounds in the Grazelands grow sleek on steppe-grass and spring-water.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.13: Master Aryon is the only Telvanni councillor who actually builds trade-roads and listens to village hetmen.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.14: When the evening wind ripples the wickwheat, the whole valley between Vos and the mountains looks like spun brass.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.15: At Rotheran, the old Dunmer stronghold ring has become an arena and slave-market for rogue outlaws.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.16: Carry marshmerrow and heather from the steppe streams; any alchemist in Tel Vos will buy them by the bundle.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.17: No wall encloses Vos—its stone arches and Imperial chapel tower stand open to the sea breeze.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.18: The Ahemmusa elders still tell how they sought a safe haven free from cliffracers and blight.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.19: Between the Telvanni wizard-lords on the coast and the Ashkhans on the plain, the Grazelands bow to no Emperor.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.20: Chew a leaf of hackle-lo, rest by a steppe spring, and thank the ancestors for one green corner in Vvardenfell.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.21: In Grazelands, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.grazelands.22: Travelers passing through Grazelands soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.

society.skycraft.say.region.azuras_coast: A jagged labyrinth of basalt sea-stacks, mushroom towers, and twilight coves, Azura's Coast stretches from the Shrine of Azura and Holamayan to Tel Fyr, Tel Aruhn, and Molag Mar.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.1: At dawn and dusk, the giant statue above the Shrine of Azura catches the first and last light off the Padomaic Sea.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.2: In Tel Fyr, the four-thousand-year-old sorcerer Divayth Fyr tends his Corprusarium beneath the mushroom halls.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.3: Tel Aruhn's great fungal spire rises above the island causeways where Archmagister Gothren rules with an iron staff.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.4: At Molag Mar, the waist-high canton walls shelter pilgrims and Buoyant Armigers at the edge of the ash-wastes.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.5: Hidden behind a magical rock-door that opens only at dawn and dusk, the Dissident Priests of Holamayan preserve the true histories.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.6: Navigating the islet maze of Azura's Coast by boat takes a helmsman who knows every submerged basalt tooth.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.7: The Erabenimsun Camp pitches its yurts on the windward bluffs where the ash-waste meets the coastal cliffs.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.8: Bal Fell's sunken Daedric spires rise out of the southern tide-channels like broken obsidian teeth.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.9: Emperor parasols grow out of the very salt-spray along the coves of Zafirbel Bay and Azura's Coast.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.10: Every pilgrim bound for the Shrine of Azura leaves moon-sugar, twilight-petals, or silver at the altar steps.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.11: Down in Tel Uvirith, the black lava-plain waits for a young Telvanni Mouth to raise a new mushroom stronghold.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.12: Dreugh and slaughterfish prowl the deep kelp trenches between the islands.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.13: In Molag Mar's underworks, the canal water comes from covered rain-cisterns guarded by Temple Ordinators.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.14: Divayth Fyr's four daughters—Alfe, Beyte, Delte, and Uupse—know every locked chest in the Hall of Fyr.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.15: Even the smugglers at Vassamsi Grotto and Yasamsi light a candle to the Queen of Dawn and Dusk before sailing.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.16: When the sea-storms lash Azura's Coast, waves leap thirty feet up the basalt columns.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.17: The Buoyant Armigers at Molag Mar wear glass armour that shines like green sea-ice in the sun.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.18: Luminous russula and bloat-spores cling to the damp root-arches under Tel Aruhn.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.19: Out on the eastern skerries, mudcrabs grow big enough to mistake for boulders until they snap.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.20: Walk Azura's Coast at twilight and you'll understand why the Dunmer still remember the Moon and Star.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.21: In Azura's Coast, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.22: Travelers passing through Azura's Coast soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.23: Every merchant caravan in Azura's Coast carries ancestral charms beside its scales and ledgers.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.24: Out on the roads of Azura's Coast, a sturdy pair of bonemold greaves is worth twice its weight in Imperial silver.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.25: Ask any elder in Azura's Coast and they can recite three centuries of House treaties from memory.
society.skycraft.say.azuras_coast.26: Whether by silt strider, coaster skiff, or stone causeway, all paths through Azura's Coast answer to ancient custom.

society.skycraft.say.region.west_gash: Cut by the Odai River canyon and dry karst ridges, the West Gash links the Hlaalu trading city of Balmora and the Imperial charter mining town of Caldera.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.1: In Balmora, the Odai River splits the Hlaalu sandstone terraces between the merchant plaza and the Manor District.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.2: Up in Caldera, the Imperial charter company runs the ebony mines under the watchful eye of Governor Halladay's keep.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.3: High above the Odai gorge, the rusted brass cranks and stone bridge of Arkngthand guard the old Dwemer halls.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.4: At Moonmoth Legion Fort, the Imperial garrison watches the crossroads where the Foyada Mamaea meets the Balmora road.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.5: Down on the coast, Hla Oad's rickety plank walkways creak over the mud-pilings and smuggler skiffs.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.6: The South Wall Cornerclub in Balmora is the first stop for anyone looking for the Thieves Guild.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.7: Over at the Council Club, Camonna Tong toughs eye every outlander who steps through the door.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.8: Caius Cosades lives in a tiny upstairs room on Balmora's east side, claiming to be nothing more than an old scholar.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.9: Every silt strider caravan from Seyda Neen to Ald'ruhn changes mounts outside Balmora's southern gate.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.10: In Caldera's Shenk's Shovel, miners spend their ebony wages alongside an eccentric scamp who buys artifacts at full value.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.11: Shulk Egg Mine and the Odai plateau supply Balmora's markets with fresh kwama eggs and guar hides.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.12: At Rethan Manor on the Odai bluff, House Hlaalu's retainers build in flat-roofed ochre plaster.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.13: Hlormaren's old Dunmer stronghold dome overlooks the western coast road like a crouched beetle.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.14: Ranis Athrys runs the Balmora Mages Guild with strict ledger discipline, while Ajira studies mushrooms in the basement.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.15: Watch the ridge-trails between Caldera and Ald'ruhn; cliffracers and kagouti love the narrow rock cuts.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.16: In the Eight Plates and the Lucky Lockup, Hlaalu factors strike deals before the ink dries on the Imperial tariffs.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.17: The Foyada Mamaea leads straight up from Moonmoth Fort toward the Ghostfence—don't follow it unprepared.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.18: Paper lanterns along Balmora's stone bridges reflect gold in the Odai water at dusk.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.19: Between House Hlaalu's coin, the Legion's steel, and the guilds' charters, the West Gash is Vvardenfell's busiest road.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.20: Keep your purse tied to your belt in Balmora's alleys and your boots dry on the Hla Oad planks.
society.skycraft.say.west_gash.21: In West Gash, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.

society.skycraft.say.region.bitter_coast: Steaming mangrove swamps, brackish tidal inlets, and smuggler caves fringe the Bitter Coast around the stilt-built fishing village of Gnaar Mok.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.1: In Gnaar Mok, every shack and net-shed stands on tarred timber stilts above the brackish swamp water.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.2: The Bitter Coast fog is so thick at dawn you can hear a bull netch groaning ten yards away before you see its tentacles.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.3: Smugglers use the sea-caves of Addamasartus and Nammu to slip skooma, moon-sugar, and raw ebony past the Excise cutters.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.4: Luminous russula, violet coprinus, and bungler's bane grow on every rotting log in the Bitter Coast mire.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.5: Watch the shallow pools for mudcrabs and slaughterfish when you wade between the mangrove roots.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.6: Out on the western headlands, sunken shipwrecks still hold East Empire crates and Barnacle-encrusted chests.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.7: At Ilunibi's flooded caverns north of Gnaar Mok, fishermen say the water itself carries a dark, feverish whisper.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.8: House Hlaalu claims Gnaar Mok on its tax-rolls, though the Camonna Tong controls what actually leaves the docks.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.9: Rub netch-oil on your ankles before walking the swamp trails or the swamp-flies will eat you alive.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.10: A flat-bottomed skiff is worth three horses anywhere between Hla Oad and Khuul.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.11: Even the Legion patrol from Seyda Neen stops where the paved stone road sinks into the Bitter Coast peat.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.12: In Arenim Manor, the planks smell of smoked slaughterfish, salt-tar, and damp guar-hide.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.13: Every cave entrance behind a waterfall on the Bitter Coast has a smuggler's lantern hanging from a stalactite.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.14: Dreugh hunters row out past the western skerries when the warm currents bring the red-shelled beasts inshore.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.15: If you see ghost-lights dancing over the peat bogs at midnight, stay on the timber boardwalks.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.16: Alchemists from Balmora pay good drakes for the spore-caps and marsh-reeds gathered along our inlets.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.17: Nothing rusts iron faster than the warm salt-mist of the Bitter Coast—that's why our guards wear chitin and boiled netch-leather.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.18: Old Velothi ancestral tombs sit half-sunk in the mud-cliffs, their doors choked with swamp-vines.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.19: When the tide goes out at Gnaar Mok, the mud-flats hiss with crabs and brine-worms.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.20: Folks on the Bitter Coast mind their nets, mind the tide, and never ask what's in a neighbour's crate.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.21: In Bitter Coast, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.22: Travelers passing through Bitter Coast soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.

society.skycraft.say.bitter_coast.24: Out on the roads of Bitter Coast, a sturdy pair of bonemold greaves is worth twice its weight in Imperial silver.

society.skycraft.say.region.ascadian_isl: Mirror-calm lakes, irrigated saltrice paddies, and giant emperor-parasol groves surround the great stepped cantons of Vivec City and the lake-market of Suran.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.1: Nine stepped cantons of Vivec City rise out of the inner bay, linked by covered bridges and gondolier canals.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.2: Above the High Fane of Vivec, the Ministry of Truth hangs frozen in the sky as a testament to the Warrior-Poet's power.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.3: In the Foreign Quarter canton, outlanders must register before crossing the southern bridges into the Great House cantons.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.4: Out on the shores of Lake Masobi, Suran's whitewashed Hlaalu terraces step down to the river docks and the House of Earthly Delights.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.5: Pelagiad looks like a piece of the Cyrodiilic Heartlands dropped into Morrowind, with its half-timber cottages and Legion fort.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.6: Down at Seyda Neen, the lighthouse beacon guides every Imperial prison ship and cargo cog into the Census and Excise dock.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.7: Along the Ascadian rivers, Dren Plantation and Arvel Plantation work wide fields of saltrice, marshmerrow, and corkbulb.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.8: The gondoliers of Vivec City can ferry you from Redoran Canton to Telvanni Canton for a single drake.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.9: In St. Olms and St. Delyn cantons, artisans and tanners live in the lower waistworks while Ordinators patrol the plazas.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.10: Ald Sotha's ruined Daedric spires east of Vivec still echo with Mehrunes Dagon's whispers and Morag Tong oaths.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.11: Nothing is more peaceful than an Ascadian morning when the mist rises off Lake Hairan beneath the giant mushrooms.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.12: In the Arena Canton of Vivec, duelists settle House disputes and Guild rankings on the sunken sand floor.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.13: Over at Tel Branora on the southern islands, Mistress Therana's mushroom tower leans precariously over the bay.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.14: Socucius Ergalla in Seyda Neen has stamped the release papers of half the outlanders walking Vvardenfell.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.15: Watch your purse near the Elven Nations Cornerclub and No Name Club in Vivec's cantons.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.16: At Castle Ebonheart and the Vivec docks, East Empire barges load Ascadian saltrice by the ton.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.17: Even the nix-hounds and guar in the Ascadian Isles seem gentler than their cousins up on the Ashlands.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.18: In the Hall of Wisdom and the Palace of Vivec, water flows through bronze channels beneath the altar steps.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.19: Walk the stone bridges between the cantons at sunset when the paper lanterns light the canals.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.20: Here in the Ascadian Isles, the land is green, the lakes are deep, and every road leads back to Vivec's cantons.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.21: In Ascadian Isles, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.22: Travelers passing through Ascadian Isles soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.23: Every merchant caravan in Ascadian Isles carries ancestral charms beside its scales and ledgers.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.24: Out on the roads of Ascadian Isles, a sturdy pair of bonemold greaves is worth twice its weight in Imperial silver.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.25: Ask any elder in Ascadian Isles and they can recite three centuries of House treaties from memory.
society.skycraft.say.ascadian_isles.26: Whether by silt strider, coaster skiff, or stone causeway, all paths through Ascadian Isles answer to ancient custom.

society.skycraft.say.region.red_mountain: Ringed by the glowing blue pylons of the Ghostfence and sealed by Ghostgate's twin citadels, Red Mountain's blighted caldera holds Dagoth Ur and the Sixth House citadels.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.1: At Ghostgate, the Tower of Dusk and the Tower of Dawn lock the only passage through the glowing Ghostfence.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.2: Inside the Ghostfence, the sky never clears—red blight-clouds and ash-thunder swirl round the caldera rim day and night.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.3: Buoyant Armigers in glass armour and Ordinators in gilded bonemold keep ceaseless vigil at Ghostgate's brass portcullis.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.4: Deep within the summit crater, the Dwemer brass bridge and steam-doors of Dagoth Ur guard the Heart Chamber.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.5: Citadels like Odrosal, Vemynal, and Tureynulal ring the inner slopes where Ash Vampires command the Sixth House.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.6: No clean water flows inside the Ghostfence; carry blessed almsivi restoration and cure-blight potions in your pack.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.7: Every pilgrim who touches the Ghostgate shrine hears the low hum of the ancestor-bones powering the great barrier.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.8: Foyadas carved by ancient lava flows—Mamaea, Bani-Dad, and Esannudan—funnel the blight-storms down to the lowlands.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.9: Corprus beasts, ash-ghouls, and ascended sleepers wander the scoria trenches above the inner caldera.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.10: Even the ebony and raw glass veins inside Red Mountain carry the feverish heat of Lorkhan's sundered Heart.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.11: In the armory of the Tower of Dusk, smiths mend shattered glass shields and re-consecrate silver spears.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.12: Never remove your ash-mask north of Ghostgate; the red dust carries both ash-chancre and black-heart blight.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.13: Up on the northern slope, the Cavern of the Incarnate opens only beneath the light of Moon and Star.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.14: The Ghostfence pylons are filled with the consecrated bones of Tribunal saints and Indoril martyrs.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.15: When Dagoth Ur stirs in the crater, the brass pipes of Odrosal shriek like a choir of bells.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.16: Only Buoyant Armigers on sworn errantry cross the threshold of Ghostgate without an Archcanon's writ.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.17: Obsidian shards along the caldera rim will cut through iron-shod boots before you reach the summit trail.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.18: Every soldier at Ghostgate remembers the companions who walked into the red mist and never returned.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.19: Stand on the ramparts of the Tower of Dawn and you can see the whole ring of Vvardenfell below the cloud-bank.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.20: Here at the mountain's throat, the Tribunal's wall holds back an ancient nightmare by faith and bone alone.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.21: In Red Mountain, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.red_mountain.22: Travelers passing through Red Mountain soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.

society.skycraft.say.region.solstheim: Split between the ash-blanketed Redoran bastion of Raven Rock in the south and the snow-clad pines, glacial peaks, and Skaal Greathall of the north, Solstheim bridges Morrowind and Skyrim.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.1: In Raven Rock, House Redoran's curved chitin-shell houses shelter behind the great southern bulwark against the ash-wind.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.2: First Councillor Lleril Morvayn and Second Councillor Adril Arano keep Raven Rock standing even with the ebony mine cold.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.3: Out on the eastern coast at Tel Mithryn, Master Neloth grows his Telvanni mushroom towers among the ash-drifts.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.4: Up north in Skaal Village, Shaman Storn Crag-Strider and his people honour the All-Maker beneath the snow-pines.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.5: Across the island, the Sacred Stones—Wind, Water, Earth, Beast, Sun, and Tree—hum with an ancient shadow from the Temple of Miraak.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.6: Don't chip at the blue stalhrim ice in the northern barrows unless you carry an ancient Nordic pickaxe and Skaal blessing.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.7: At the Retching Netch in Raven Rock, Geldis Sadri pours sujamma strong enough to thaw Moesring glacier-ice.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.8: Captain Veleth's Redoran Guard patrols the bulwark day and night against ash spawn rising from the southern wastes.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.9: High in the northern glaciers, the icy ruins of Castle Karstaag still echo with Riekling war-horns and frost-storms.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.10: At Thirsk Mead Hall on the shore of Lake Fjalding, Nordic warriors and Riekling tribes fight over the longhouse.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.11: Down in Bloodskal Barrow beneath the Raven Rock mine, red energy-runes still glow in the ancient Draugr crypt.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.12: Fahlbtharz and Kagrumez hide steaming Dwemer gears and tonal resonance locks under the Moesring snows.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.13: In Brodir Grove, the ancient standing stones stand where ash-plain meets northern pine.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.14: Frostmoon Crag's hunters keep to themselves when the full moon rises over the Moesring peaks.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.15: Every ship pulling into Raven Rock's timber dock is the Northern Maiden out of Windhelm, captained by Gjalund Salt-Sage.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.16: Netches and silt striders graze the southern ash-moss while horkers and snow-bears roam the Felsaad coast.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.17: Glover Mallory at the Raven Rock forge knows a shadowmark when he sees one carved on a doorframe.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.18: In the Temple of Miraak at the center of the island, black tentacles and dragon-priest runes twist beneath the stone.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.19: Whether you swear by the Reclamations in Raven Rock or the All-Maker in Skaal Village, Solstheim tests every traveler.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.20: Here on the island of ash and rime, Redoran bonemold and Skaal stalhrim stand side by side against the dark.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.21: In Solstheim, the temple bells and council gongs mark every watch from dawn to the second moon.
society.skycraft.say.solstheim.22: Travelers passing through Solstheim soon learn to read the wind, the ash-plume, and the House banners.
